title: The Grito de Lares and 1898
goal: Tell what happened in 1868 and 1898 and put events in order with *antes de que* and *después de que*.
grammar: antes de que and después de que, applied to 1868 and 1898

items: I can say that one event happened before or after another with *antes de que* and *después de que*.
I can say what happened in Lares in 1868 and what the Treaty of Paris did in 1898.
I can use the new words for uprising, cession, slavery and treaty.
